local function ensureToolEquipped(toolName, unequipOthers)
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local backpack = LocalPlayer.Backpack
    
    if not character then return false, nil end
    
    if unequipOthers then
        for _, item in ipairs(character:GetChildren()) do
            if item:IsA("Tool") and item.Name ~= toolName then
                item.Parent = backpack
            end
        end
    end
    
    local equippedTool = character:FindFirstChild(toolName)
    if equippedTool and equippedTool:IsA("Tool") then
        return true, equippedTool
    end
    
    local backpackTool = backpack:FindFirstChild(toolName)
    if backpackTool and backpackTool:IsA("Tool") then
        backpackTool.Parent = character
        return true, character:FindFirstChild(toolName)
    end
    
    return false, nil
end

local function makeDraggable(frame, handle)
    handle = handle or frame
    local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
    
    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position
            input.Changed:Connect(function()
                if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                    dragging = false
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
    
    frame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end)
    
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input == dragInput and dragging then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            frame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
end

local function serverHop()
    statusLabel.Text = "finding new server..."
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        local servers = {}
        local req = game:HttpGet("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. game.PlaceId .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100")
        local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(req)
        for _, s in ipairs(data.data) do
            if s.playing < s.maxPlayers and s.id ~= game.JobId then
                table.insert(servers, s.id)
            end
        end
        if #servers > 0 then
            return servers[math.random(1, #servers)]
        end
        return nil
    end)

    if success and result then
        statusLabel.Text = "teleporting to new server..."
        TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, result, LocalPlayer)
    else
        statusLabel.Text = "hop failed, retrying in 3s..."
        task.wait(3)
        serverHop()
    end
end

local function setSize(val)
	local c=LP.Character
	local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if rigMode=="R15"and h.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15 then
		h.AutomaticScalingEnabled=true
		for _,n in ipairs({"BodyHeightScale","BodyWidthScale","BodyDepthScale","HeadScale"})do
			local s=h:FindFirstChild(n)
			if not s then s=Instance.new("NumberValue",h)s.Name=n end
			s.Value=val
		end
		pcall(function()h:BuildRigFromAttachments()end)
	else
		for _,p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants())do
			if p:IsA("BasePart")and p.Name~="HumanoidRootPart"then
				if not origData[p]then origData[p]={sz=p.Size}end
				p.Size=origData[p].sz*val
				p.Massless=(val>1)
			elseif p:IsA("Motor6D")then
				if not origData[p]then origData[p]={c0=p.C0,c1=p.C1}end
				local d=origData[p]
				p.C0=CFrame.new(d.c0.Position*val)*(d.c0-d.c0.Position)
				p.C1=CFrame.new(d.c1.Position*val)*(d.c1-d.c1.Position)
			elseif p:IsA("SpecialMesh")then
				if not origData[p]then origData[p]={ms=p.Scale}end
				p.Scale=origData[p].ms*val
			end
		end
		if h.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then h.HipHeight=(val-1)*2 end
	end
	r.CFrame=r.CFrame+Vector3.new(0,math.max(1,val*1.5),0)
end

-- Variables de configuración (Triángulo con radio 60)
local isLooping = false
local RADIUS = 60 -- Radio de 60 studs
local INITIAL_SPEED = 50
local SPEED_INCREMENT = 100 -- Incrementa 100 cada 1 segundo
local MAX_EXTREME_SPEED = 100000 -- Límite máximo de velocidad en 100,000

-- Función del bucle limpio en triángulo
local function startTriangleLoop()
    task.spawn(function()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait()
        local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        local centerCFrame = hrp.CFrame
        local centerPos = centerCFrame.Position
        
        -- Calculamos los 3 vértices del triángulo equilátero con radio 60
        local vertices = {}
        for i = 0, 2 do
            local angle = math.rad(i * 120)
            local offsetX = math.cos(angle) * RADIUS
            local offsetZ = math.sin(angle) * RADIUS
            table.insert(vertices, centerPos + Vector3.new(offsetX, 0, offsetZ))
        end
        
        local currentIndex = 1
        local currentSpeed = INITIAL_SPEED
        local timeElapsedSinceIncrease = 0
        
        SpeedLabel.Text = "Velocidad: " .. currentSpeed
        
        while isLooping do
            character = LocalPlayer.Character
            hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then break end
            
            local targetPos = vertices[currentIndex]
            local distance = (targetPos - hrp.Position).Magnitude
            
            local duration = distance / currentSpeed
            if duration < 0.0001 then duration = 0.0001 end
            
            local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos) * (centerCFrame - centerCFrame.Position)
            local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
            local tween = TweenService:Create(hrp, tweenInfo, {CFrame = targetCFrame})
            
            tween:Play()
            
            local elapsed = 0
            while elapsed < duration and isLooping do
                local dt = task.wait()
                elapsed = elapsed + dt
                timeElapsedSinceIncrease = timeElapsedSinceIncrease + dt
                
                if timeElapsedSinceIncrease >= 1 then
                    timeElapsedSinceIncrease = 0
                    if currentSpeed < MAX_EXTREME_SPEED then
                        currentSpeed = currentSpeed + SPEED_INCREMENT
                        SpeedLabel.Text = "Velocidad: " .. currentSpeed
                    end
                end
            end
            
            if not isLooping then
                tween:Cancel()
                break
            end
            
            -- Pasar al siguiente vértice del triángulo (1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 1)
            currentIndex = (currentIndex % 3) + 1
        end
        SpeedLabel.Text = "Velocidad: 50 (Pausado)"
    end)
end

-- Evento del botón de Triángulo
TriangleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isLooping = not isLooping
    
    if isLooping then
        TriangleBtn.Text = "TP Triángulo: ON"
        TriangleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170)
        TriangleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 55, 45)
        startTriangleLoop()
    else
        TriangleBtn.Text = "TP Triángulo: OFF"
        TriangleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
        TriangleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50)
        SpeedLabel.Text = "Velocidad: 50"
    end
end)

    if not id then
        status.Text = "⚠ Invalid Sound ID"
        status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 120, 120)
        return
    end
    sound:Stop()
    sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. id
    sound.Looped  = true
    sound:Play()
    status.Text = "▶ Playing (loop) - ID: " .. id
    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 120)

    status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 120)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------

    sound:Destroy()
    gui:Destroy()
end)

    if minimized then
        frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 28)
        for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child ~= title then
                child.Visible = false
            end
        end
        minBtn.Text = "+"
    else
        frame.Size = expandedSize
        for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                child.Visible = true
            end
        end
        minBtn.Text = "-"
    end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------
-- Drag (grab the title bar)
------------------------------------------------------------
local dragging, dragStart, startPos

title.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos  = frame.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        frame.Position = UDim2.new(
            startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
            startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        )
    end
end)

-- ==============================================================================
-- //                   MB ADMIN - ULTIMATE FINAL EDITION (v4.0)                //
-- //      Full Mobil Destekli Akıllı Uçuş + Canlı Dönen Gradient + IY Paketi    //
-- ==============================================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Prefix = ";"

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 1. BUZLU CAM (BLUR) KATMANI
-- ==============================================================================
local Blur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("MB_MasterBlur")
if not Blur then
    Blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
    Blur.Name = "MB_MasterBlur"
    Blur.Size = 0
    Blur.Parent = Lighting
end

local function setBlur(active)
    TweenService:Create(Blur, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
        Size = active and 20 or 0
    }):Play()
end

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 2. EKRAN GUI
-- ==============================================================================
local oldUI = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("MB_FinalUI") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):FindFirstChild("MB_FinalUI")
if oldUI then oldUI:Destroy() end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "MB_FinalUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
pcall(function() ScreenGui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not ScreenGui.Parent then ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 3. MOBİLDE PARMAKLA SÜRÜKLENEBİLİR FLOATING BUTON
-- ==============================================================================
local OpenButton = Instance.new("TextButton", ScreenGui)
OpenButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 52)
OpenButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0.45, 0)
OpenButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
OpenButton.Text = ""

local BtnBg = Instance.new("Frame", OpenButton)
BtnBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
BtnBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
BtnBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
BtnBg.ZIndex = 1
Instance.new("UICorner", BtnBg).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

local BtnGradient = Instance.new("UIGradient", BtnBg)
BtnGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(8, 25, 65)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255))
})

local BtnStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", BtnBg)
BtnStroke.Thickness = 2.4
BtnStroke.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border

local BtnStrokeGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", BtnStroke)
BtnStrokeGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(130, 50, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 255))
})

local BtnLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel", OpenButton)
BtnLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
BtnLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
BtnLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
BtnLabel.Text = "MB"
BtnLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
BtnLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 20)
BtnLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
BtnLabel.TextSize = 18
BtnLabel.ZIndex = 2

-- Parmakla Sürükleme Motoru
local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos
local dragMoved = false

OpenButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragMoved = false
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = OpenButton.Position

        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        if delta.Magnitude > 6 then
            dragMoved = true
            OpenButton.Position = UDim2.new(
                startPos.X.Scale,
                startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                startPos.Y.Scale,
                startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )
        end
    end
end)

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 4. COMMAND BAR & YAZARKEN CANLI YANAN METİN
-- ==============================================================================
local BarFrame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)
BarFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 48)
local MaxConstraint = Instance.new("UISizeConstraint", BarFrame)
MaxConstraint.MaxSize = Vector2.new(460, 48)

BarFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -230, 1, 80)
BarFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
BarFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.08
BarFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
Instance.new("UICorner", BarFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

-- Renk Paletleri
local BarColorsNormal = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(15, 12, 28)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(24, 18, 45)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(12, 10, 22))
})
local BarColorsCommand = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(8, 22, 45)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(10, 40, 75)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(5, 18, 35))
})

local StrokeColorsNormal = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(160, 60, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(90, 40, 200)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(190, 80, 255))
})
local StrokeColorsCommand = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(100, 230, 255))
})

local InputColorsNormal = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 220))
})
local InputColorsCommand = ColorSequence.new({
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.0, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)),
    ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1.0, Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 255))
})

local BarBgGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", BarFrame)
BarBgGrad.Color = BarColorsNormal

local BarStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", BarFrame)
BarStroke.Thickness = 2
local BarStrokeGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", BarStroke)
BarStrokeGrad.Color = StrokeColorsNormal

local ModeIndicator = Instance.new("TextLabel", BarFrame)
ModeIndicator.Size = UDim2.new(0, 45, 1, 0)
ModeIndicator.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
ModeIndicator.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ModeIndicator.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
ModeIndicator.Text = "MB"
ModeIndicator.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ModeIndicator.TextSize = 14

local TextGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", ModeIndicator)
TextGrad.Color = StrokeColorsNormal

local CmdBox = Instance.new("TextBox", BarFrame)
CmdBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -95, 1, 0)
CmdBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 0)
CmdBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
CmdBox.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CmdBox.PlaceholderText = "';' yazınca yazı mavi gradient olur amk..."
CmdBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 140)
CmdBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CmdBox.TextSize = 15
CmdBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
CmdBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

-- Metnin Kendi Üzerine Canlı Gradient
local BoxTextGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", CmdBox)
BoxTextGrad.Color = InputColorsNormal

-- Kutusuz Minimalist Yukarı Ok (↑)
local SendBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", BarFrame)
SendBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36)
SendBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0.5, -18)
SendBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SendBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
SendBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
SendBtn.Text = "↑"
SendBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
SendBtn.TextSize = 24

local SendBtnGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient", SendBtn)
SendBtnGrad.Color = StrokeColorsNormal

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 5. CANLI DÖNÜŞ VE REAKTİF RENK DEĞİŞİMİ
-- ==============================================================================
local rot = 0
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    rot = (rot + dt * 80) % 360
    BtnGradient.Rotation = rot
    BtnStrokeGrad.Rotation = (rot + 90) % 360
    BarBgGrad.Rotation = (rot * 0.5) % 360
    BarStrokeGrad.Rotation = rot
    TextGrad.Rotation = rot
    SendBtnGrad.Rotation = rot
    BoxTextGrad.Rotation = rot
end)

-- Metin Kutusu Dinleyicisi (Yazarken Anında Mavi Fırtına)
CmdBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local text = CmdBox.Text
    local isCommand = text:sub(1, 1) == Prefix

    if isCommand then
        BarBgGrad.Color = BarColorsCommand
        BarStrokeGrad.Color = StrokeColorsCommand
        TextGrad.Color = StrokeColorsCommand
        SendBtnGrad.Color = StrokeColorsCommand
        BoxTextGrad.Color = InputColorsCommand
        ModeIndicator.Text = "CMD"
    else
        BarBgGrad.Color = BarColorsNormal
        BarStrokeGrad.Color = StrokeColorsNormal
        TextGrad.Color = StrokeColorsNormal
        SendBtnGrad.Color = StrokeColorsNormal
        BoxTextGrad.Color = InputColorsNormal
        ModeIndicator.Text = "MB"
    end
end)

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 6. AÇILMA / KAPANMA
-- ==============================================================================
local isOpen = false

local function toggleBar(state)
    isOpen = state
    setBlur(isOpen)
    local targetPos = isOpen and UDim2.new(0.5, -BarFrame.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, 1, -75) or UDim2.new(0.5, -BarFrame.AbsoluteSize.X / 2, 1, 80)
    BarFrame:TweenPosition(targetPos, isOpen and Enum.EasingDirection.Out or Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, 0.35, true)

    if isOpen then
        task.wait(0.05)
        CmdBox:CaptureFocus()
    else
        CmdBox:ReleaseFocus()
    end
end

OpenButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not dragMoved then
        toggleBar(not isOpen)
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Backquote or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.F2 then
        toggleBar(not isOpen)
    end
end)

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 7. YARDIMCI OYUNCU FONKSİYONLARI
-- ==============================================================================
local function getCharacter() return LocalPlayer.Character or LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Wait() end
local function getHumanoid() local c = getCharacter() return c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end
local function getRoot() local c = getCharacter() return c and (c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or c:FindFirstChild("Torso")) end
local function findPlayer(name)
    if not name or name == "" then return nil end
    name = name:lower()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and (p.Name:lower():sub(1, #name) == name or p.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #name) == name) then
            return p
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 8. KOMUTLAR & MOBİL UYUMLU AKILLI UÇUŞ
-- ==============================================================================
local Commands = {}
local States = { Noclip = false, Flying = false, InfJump = false, ClickTp = false }
local flySpeed = 50
local flyBV, flyBG
local spinBV
local antiFlingActive = false

-- [KUSURSUZ MOBİL & PC UYUMLU SMART FLY]
Commands["fly"] = function(args)
    if States.Flying then return end
    States.Flying = true
    flySpeed = tonumber(args[1]) or 50

    local root = getRoot()
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if not root or not hum then return end

    hum.PlatformStand = true

    flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity", root)
    flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.zero
    flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)

    flyBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro", root)
    flyBG.CFrame = root.CFrame
    flyBG.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
    flyBG.P = 9e4

    task.spawn(function()
        while States.Flying and root and hum and flyBV and flyBG do
            local moveDir = Vector3.zero

            if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                local flatLook = Vector3.new(Camera.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, Camera.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
                local flatRight = Vector3.new(Camera.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, Camera.CFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit

                local forwardAmount = hum.MoveDirection:Dot(flatLook)
                local rightAmount = hum.MoveDirection:Dot(flatRight)

                moveDir = (Camera.CFrame.LookVector * forwardAmount) + (Camera.CFrame.RightVector * rightAmount)
                if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                    moveDir = moveDir.Unit
                end
            end

            flyBV.Velocity = moveDir * flySpeed
            flyBG.CFrame = Camera.CFrame
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end

Commands["unfly"] = function()
    States.Flying = false
    local hum = getHumanoid()
    if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
    if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy() end
    if flyBG then flyBG:Destroy() end
end

-- [TEMEL HAREKET]
Commands["speed"] = function(args) local h = getHumanoid() if h then h.WalkSpeed = tonumber(args[1]) or 16 end end
Commands["jump"] = function(args) local h = getHumanoid() if h then h.UseJumpPower = true h.JumpPower = tonumber(args[1]) or 50 end end
Commands["noclip"] = function() States.Noclip = true end
Commands["clip"] = function() States.Noclip = false end
Commands["infjump"] = function() States.InfJump = not States.InfJump end
Commands["clicktp"] = function() States.ClickTp = not States.ClickTp end

-- [TROLL & COMBAT]
Commands["fling"] = function(args)
    local target = findPlayer(args[1] or "")
    local root = getRoot()
    if not target or not target.Character or not root then return end
    local tRoot = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
    if not tRoot then return end

    local bav = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", root)
    bav.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bav.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(99999, 99999, 99999)

    local flingActive = true
    task.spawn(function()
        local t0 = tick()
        while flingActive and (tick() - t0 < 2.5) and tRoot and root do
            root.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(math.random(-1, 1), 0, math.random(-1, 1))
            task.wait()
        end
        bav:Destroy()
    end)
end

Commands["antifling"] = function()
    antiFlingActive = not antiFlingActive
    if antiFlingActive then
        RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if antiFlingActive then
                for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                    if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
                        for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

Commands["invis"] = function()
    local char = getCharacter()
    if not char then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Decal") then part.Transparency = 1 end
    end
end

Commands["vis"] = function()
    local char = getCharacter()
    if not char then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            part.Transparency = 0
        elseif part:IsA("Decal") then
            part.Transparency = 0
        end
    end
end

Commands["spin"] = function(args)
    local root = getRoot()
    if not root then return end
    local spd = tonumber(args[1]) or 30
    if spinBV then spinBV:Destroy() end
    spinBV = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", root)
    spinBV.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0)
    spinBV.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, spd, 0)
end

Commands["unspin"] = function()
    if spinBV then spinBV:Destroy() end
end

-- [GÖRSEL & EXPLOIT ARAÇLARI]
Commands["esp"] = function()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and not p.Character:FindFirstChild("MB_HL") then
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight", p.Character)
            hl.Name = "MB_HL"
            hl.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 229, 255)
            hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        end
    end
end

Commands["unesp"] = function()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Character and p.Character:FindFirstChild("MB_HL") then
            p.Character.MB_HL:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

Commands["fb"] = function()
    Lighting.Brightness = 2
    Lighting.ClockTime = 14
    Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
end

Commands["btools"] = function()
    for i = 1, 4 do
        local t = Instance.new("HopperBin")
        t.BinType = i
        t.Parent = LocalPlayer.Backpack
    end
end

Commands["dex"] = function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Babyhamsta/RBLX_Scripts/main/Universal/BypassedDarkDexV3.lua"))()
end

Commands["rspy"] = function()
    loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/exxtremestuffs/SimpleSpy/master/source.lua"))()
end

-- [TELEPORT & SUNUCU]
Commands["tp"] = function(args)
    local target = findPlayer(args[1])
    local root = getRoot()
    if target and target.Character and root then
        local tRoot = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or target.Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if tRoot then root.CFrame = tRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3) end
    end
end

Commands["view"] = function(args)
    local t = findPlayer(args[1] or "")
    if t and t.Character and t.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        Camera.CameraSubject = t.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    end
end

Commands["unview"] = function()
    local h = getHumanoid()
    if h then Camera.CameraSubject = h end
end

Commands["rj"] = function()
    TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, game.JobId, LocalPlayer)
end

Commands["shop"] = function()
    local placeId = game.PlaceId
    local serversUrl = "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/" .. placeId .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(serversUrl))
    end)
    if success and result and result.data then
        for _, s in ipairs(result.data) do
            if s.playing < s.maxPlayers and s.id ~= game.JobId then
                TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(placeId, s.id, LocalPlayer)
                break
            end
        end
    end
end
Commands["serverhop"] = Commands["shop"]

-- ==============================================================================
-- // 9. KOMUT ÇALIŞTIRICI & SİSTEM BAĞLANTILARI
-- ==============================================================================
local function executeText(text)
    if not text or text == "" then return end
    if text:sub(1, #Prefix) == Prefix then text = text:sub(#Prefix + 1) end

    local args = {}
    for word in text:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(args, word) end

    local cmd = table.remove(args, 1)
    if cmd and Commands[cmd:lower()] then
        pcall(function() Commands[cmd:lower()](args) end)
    end
end

SendBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    executeText(CmdBox.Text)
    CmdBox.Text = ""
    toggleBar(false)
end)

CmdBox.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
    if enterPressed then
        executeText(CmdBox.Text)
        CmdBox.Text = ""
        toggleBar(false)
    end
end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if States.Noclip then
        local c = LocalPlayer.Character
        if c then
            for _, p in ipairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.CanCollide then p.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end
end)

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if States.InfJump then
        local h = getHumanoid()
        if h then h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping) end
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)

local Connections = {}
local FrameFn, IntegrityFn
local Gui

local function connect(signal, fn)
    local c = signal:Connect(fn)
    table.insert(Connections, c)
    return c
end

local function hasConst(fn, value)
    local ok, constants = pcall(debug.getconstants, fn)
    if not ok or type(constants) ~= "table" then return false end

    for _, v in pairs(constants) do
        if v == value then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function patch()
    if type(getgc) ~= "function" or type(debug) ~= "table" then return end
    if not debug.getconstants or not debug.getupvalues or not debug.setupvalue then return end

    local ok, objects = pcall(getgc, false)
    if not ok or type(objects) ~= "table" then return end

    for _, fn in pairs(objects) do
        if type(fn) == "function" then
            local success, ups = pcall(debug.getupvalues, fn)

            if success and type(ups) == "table" then
                if #ups == 35 and not FrameFn then
                    for _, v in pairs(ups) do
                        if type(v) == "function" then
                            if hasConst(v, "SetWalkSpeed") or hasConst(v, "BeginImpulse") then
                                FrameFn = fn
                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                if #ups == 19 and not IntegrityFn then
                    if hasConst(fn, "Character integrity evaluator returned an invalid completion receipt") then
                        IntegrityFn = fn
                    end
                end

                if FrameFn and IntegrityFn then break end
            end
        end
    end

    if IntegrityFn and debug.getupvalue then
        pcall(function()
            local receipt = debug.getupvalue(IntegrityFn, 16)
            if receipt ~= nil then
                debug.setupvalue(IntegrityFn, 1, function()
                    return receipt
                end)
            end
        end)
    end
end

    end)

        BorderSizePixel = 0,

    }, panel)

    round(copy, 4)

    copy.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        copy.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover
    end)

    copy.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        copy.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button
    end)

    copy.Activated:Connect(function()
        local clipboard = setclipboard or toclipboard
        local copied = type(clipboard) == "function" and pcall(clipboard, "https://discord.gg/axonic")

    end)

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

        lastViewport = viewport
        scale.Scale = math.clamp(

    end)

local function matchesRPKey(s)
    local l = string.lower(s or "")
    return l:find("rp", 1, true) or l:find("name", 1, true) or l:find("tag", 1, true)
        or l:find("bio", 1, true) or l:find("title", 1, true) or l:find("nick", 1, true) or l:find("roleplay", 1, true)

local function applyRP(txt)
    rpTag = (txt and txt ~= "") and txt or rpTag
    pcall(function()
        for _, v in ipairs(RS:GetDescendants()) do
            if matchesRPKey(v.Name) then
                if v:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
                    v:FireServer("RolePlayName", rpTag)
                    v:FireServer("RPName", rpTag)
                    v:FireServer("SetName", rpTag)
                    v:FireServer(rpTag)

                        pcall(function() v:InvokeServer("RolePlayName", rpTag) end)
                        pcall(function() v:InvokeServer(rpTag) end)
                    end)
                end
            end
        end

        local pg = player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
        if pg then
            for _, g in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
                if not g:IsDescendantOf(GuiRoot) then
                    if g:IsA("TextBox") and (matchesRPKey(g.Name) or matchesRPKey(g.PlaceholderText)) then
                        g.Text = rpTag
                    elseif g:IsA("TextLabel") and matchesRPKey(g.Name) then
                        g.Text = rpTag
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local ch = player.Character

            for _, d in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do

                    d.Text = rpTag

local function toggleControls(enable)
    local touchGui = pg:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
    if touchGui then
        local jumpBtn = touchGui:FindFirstChild("JumpButton")
        if not jumpBtn then
            local tcf = touchGui:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
            if tcf then jumpBtn = tcf:FindFirstChild("JumpButton") end
        end
        if jumpBtn then jumpBtn.Visible = enable end
    end

    local playerScripts = p:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
    if playerScripts then
        local pm = playerScripts:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
        if pm then
            local success, controls = pcall(function() return require(pm):GetControls() end)
            if success and controls then
                if enable then controls:Enable() else controls:Disable() end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 4. LÓGICA
-- ==========================================
local function resetCamera()
    local char = p.Character
    if char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        end
    end
    isSpectating = false
    controlFrame.Visible = false
    stopBtn.Visible = false
    listFrame.Visible = true
    toggleControls(true)
end

local function spectatePlayer(index)
    if #playerList == 0 then return end
    if index > #playerList then index = 1 end
    if index < 1 then index = #playerList end
    
    currentIndex = index
    local target = playerList[currentIndex]
    
    if target and target.Character then
        local hum = target.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
            cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            isSpectating = true
            listFrame.Visible = false
            controlFrame.Visible = true
            stopBtn.Visible = true
            toggleControls(false)
        end
    else
        spectatePlayer(currentIndex + 1)
    end
end

local function updateList()
    for _, v in pairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do
        if v:IsA("TextButton") then v:Destroy() end
    end
    
    playerList = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(P:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= p then table.insert(playerList, plr) end
    end
    
    for i, plr in ipairs(playerList) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton", scroll)
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 35)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
        btn.Text = plr.Name
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        btn.TextSize = 12
        btn.LayoutOrder = i
        btn.ZIndex = 11
        Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
        
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spectatePlayer(i) end)
    end
    
    task.wait(0.05)
    scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 10)
end

-- ==========================================
-- 5. CONEXÕES
-- ==========================================
toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    listFrame.Visible = not listFrame.Visible
    if listFrame.Visible then updateList() end
end)

P.PlayerAdded:Connect(function()
    if listFrame.Visible then updateList() end
end)

P.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
    if listFrame.Visible then updateList() end
    if isSpectating and playerList[currentIndex] == plr then
        resetCamera()
    end
end)

prevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spectatePlayer(currentIndex - 1) end)
nextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() spectatePlayer(currentIndex + 1) end)
stopBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(resetCamera)

toggleTpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    autoExitOnTP = not autoExitOnTP
    if autoExitOnTP then
        toggleTpBtn.Text = "Sair após Teleporte: ON"
        toggleTpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 100)
    else
        toggleTpBtn.Text = "Sair após Teleporte: OFF"
        toggleTpBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
    end
end)

tpBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not isSpectating then return end
    local target = playerList[currentIndex]
    if target and target.Character and p.Character then
        local targetRoot = target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if targetRoot then
            p.Character:PivotTo(targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 4))
            if autoExitOnTP then
                resetCamera()
            end
        end
    end
end)

R.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if isSpectating then
        local target = playerList[currentIndex]
        if not target or not target.Character or not target.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") or target.Character.Humanoid.Health <= 0 then
            if #playerList > 1 then
                spectatePlayer(currentIndex + 1)
            else
                resetCamera()
            end
        end
    end
end)

print("[Spectate] Pronto e Rodando! UI Fixa.")

local sound = Instance.new("Sound")

local function getMuffledTargetVolume(snd)
	if snd == sound then
		return MUFFLED_MUSIC_VOLUME
	end
	local orig = muffledSavedVolumes[snd]
	if typeof(orig) == "number" then
		return math.clamp(orig * 0.85, 0.06, 10)
	end
	return nil
end

local function collectPlayingSounds()
	local list = {}
	local seen = {}

	local function addIfPlaying(obj)
		if obj and obj:IsA("Sound") and not seen[obj] then
			seen[obj] = true
			local isActive = false
			pcall(function()
				isActive = obj.IsPlaying or (obj == sound and musicEnabled)
			end)
			if isActive then
				table.insert(list, obj)
			end
		end
	end

	if sound and sound.Parent then
		addIfPlaying(sound)
	end

	for _, container in ipairs({ SoundService, CoreGui, workspace }) do
		pcall(function()
			for _, desc in ipairs(container:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("Sound") and desc.IsPlaying then
					addIfPlaying(desc)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local pg = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if pg then
		pcall(function()
			for _, desc in ipairs(pg:GetDescendants()) do
				if desc:IsA("Sound") and desc.IsPlaying then
					addIfPlaying(desc)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	return list
end

local function applyMuffledMusicEffect(enable)
	if musicDeleted then return end
	muffledStateActive = enable

	if enable then
		for _, snd in ipairs(collectPlayingSounds()) do
			pcall(function()
				if muffledSavedVolumes[snd] == nil then
					muffledSavedVolumes[snd] = (snd == sound) and BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME or snd.Volume
				end

				local eq = muffledEqualizers[snd]
				if not eq or not eq.Parent then
					eq = snd:FindFirstChild("KM_Muffled_EQ")
					if not eq then
						eq = Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")
						eq.Name = "KM_Muffled_EQ"
						eq.LowGain = 4.0
						eq.MidGain = -9
						eq.HighGain = -20
						eq.Enabled = true
						eq.Parent = snd
					end
					muffledEqualizers[snd] = eq
				end
				eq.LowGain = 4.0
				eq.MidGain = -9
				eq.HighGain = -20
				eq.Enabled = true

				local targetVol = getMuffledTargetVolume(snd)
				if targetVol then
					TweenService:Create(
						snd,
						TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{ Volume = targetVol }
					):Play()
				end
			end)
		end
	else
		for snd, eq in pairs(muffledEqualizers) do
			pcall(function()
				if eq and eq.Parent then
					eq:Destroy()
				end
			end)
			muffledEqualizers[snd] = nil
		end

		for snd, origVol in pairs(muffledSavedVolumes) do
			pcall(function()
				if snd and snd.Parent then
					local restoreVol = (snd == sound) and BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME or origVol
					TweenService:Create(
						snd,
						TweenInfo.new(0.22, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
						{ Volume = restoreVol }
					):Play()
				end
			end)
			muffledSavedVolumes[snd] = nil
		end

		if sound and sound.Parent then
			pcall(function()
				sound.Volume = BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function attachSoundParent()
	if musicDeleted or not sound then return end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		sound.Parent = CoreGui
	end)
	if not ok or not sound.Parent then
		pcall(function()
			sound.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
		end)
	end
end

local function advanceIndex()
	currentTrackIndex = currentTrackIndex + 1
	if currentTrackIndex > #playlist then
		currentTrackIndex = 1
	end
end

local lastTrackSwitchTick = 0
local isSwitchingTrack = false

local function playTrackAtIndex(idx)
	if musicDeleted or not sound or isSwitchingTrack then return end
	isSwitchingTrack = true
	lastTrackSwitchTick = tick()
	trackGeneration = trackGeneration + 1
	local myGen = trackGeneration

	local wrappedIdx = ((idx - 1) % #playlist) + 1
	currentTrackIndex = wrappedIdx
	refreshTrackInfo()

	if sound.Parent == nil then
		attachSoundParent()
	end

	local nextAssetId = playlist[currentTrackIndex] or ""
	pcall(function()
		sound.Looped = false
		sound:Stop()
		sound.SoundId = ""
		sound.TimePosition = 0
		sound.SoundId = nextAssetId
		sound.Volume = muffledStateActive and MUFFLED_MUSIC_VOLUME or BASE_MUSIC_VOLUME
		if musicEnabled and nextAssetId ~= "" then
			sound:Play()
		end
	end)

	task.delay(0.15, function()
		if trackGeneration == myGen and sound and not musicDeleted then
			pcall(function()
				if musicEnabled and not sound.IsPlaying and sound.SoundId == nextAssetId then
					sound.TimePosition = 0
					sound:Play()
				end
			end)
		end
		isSwitchingTrack = false
	end)

	if muffledStateActive then
		task.defer(function()
			applyMuffledMusicEffect(true)
		end)
	end
end

local function triggerNextTrack()
	if musicDeleted or not musicEnabled or isSwitchingTrack then return end
	if (tick() - lastTrackSwitchTick) < 0.45 then return end
	local nextIdx = (currentTrackIndex % #playlist) + 1
	playTrackAtIndex(nextIdx)
end

sound.Ended:Connect(function()
	if musicDeleted or not musicEnabled then return end
	triggerNextTrack()
end)

-- Nadzór końca utworu (także gdy dźwięk nie zdąży się załadować i ma TimeLength == 0 po próbie odtworzenia)
task.spawn(function()
	local zeroLengthTicks = 0
	local lastId = ""
	while true do
		task.wait(0.25)
		if musicDeleted then break end
		pcall(function()
			if not musicEnabled or not sound or isSwitchingTrack then
				zeroLengthTicks = 0
				return
			end

			if sound.SoundId ~= lastId then
				lastId = sound.SoundId
				zeroLengthTicks = 0
			end

			if sound.Parent == nil then
				attachSoundParent()
			end

			if not sound.IsPlaying and sound.SoundId ~= "" and (tick() - lastTrackSwitchTick) > 0.6 then
				sound:Play()
			end

			if muffledStateActive then
				applyMuffledMusicEffect(true)
			end

			local length = sound.TimeLength
			if length > 0 then
				zeroLengthTicks = 0
				if sound.TimePosition >= (length - 0.2) then
					triggerNextTrack()
				end
			elseif sound.IsPlaying then
				zeroLengthTicks = zeroLengthTicks + 1
				if zeroLengthTicks >= 20 then
					zeroLengthTicks = 0
					triggerNextTrack()
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end)

playTrackAtIndex(currentTrackIndex)

-- Licznik FPS i pingu na górze obok przycisku "-"
local fpsFrames = 0
local fpsAccumulator = 0
local currentFps = 60
local currentPing = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	fpsFrames = fpsFrames + 1
	fpsAccumulator = fpsAccumulator + dt
	if fpsAccumulator >= 0.5 then
		currentFps = math.clamp(math.round(fpsFrames / fpsAccumulator), 1, 999)
		fpsFrames = 0
		fpsAccumulator = 0

		pcall(function()
			local netItem = Stats.Network and Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem and Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]
			if netItem then
				currentPing = math.clamp(math.round(netItem:GetValue()), 0, 9999)
			end
		end)

		if perfLabel and perfLabel.Parent then
			perfLabel.Text = string.format("%d FPS | %dms", currentFps, currentPing)
		end
	end
end)

-- Animacja białej ramki: zmiana na zielony/czerwony, pętla i powrót do koloru motywu
local strokePulseToken = 0
local GREEN_STROKE = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
local RED_STROKE = Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)

local function pulseStrokeColor(isOn)
	if not panelStroke or not panelStroke.Parent then return end
	strokePulseToken = strokePulseToken + 1
	local myToken = strokePulseToken

	local activeDef = THEMES[currentThemeName] or THEMES["NORMAL THEME"]
	local baseStroke = activeDef.strokeColor
	local accentColor = isOn and GREEN_STROKE or RED_STROKE
	local dimAccent = isOn and Color3.fromRGB(35, 130, 65) or Color3.fromRGB(130, 35, 35)

	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(function()
			panelStroke.Color = accentColor
			if strokePulseToken ~= myToken then return end

			local t1 = TweenService:Create(panelStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Color = dimAccent })
			t1:Play()
			t1.Completed:Wait()
			if strokePulseToken ~= myToken then return end

			local t2 = TweenService:Create(panelStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Color = accentColor })
			t2:Play()
			t2.Completed:Wait()
			if strokePulseToken ~= myToken then return end

			local t3 = TweenService:Create(panelStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Color = baseStroke })
			t3:Play()
		end)
	end)
end

-- Płynne animowanie minimalizowania panelu i powrotu do poprzedniego rozmiaru oraz pozycji
local slideToken = 0

local function applyMinimizeState(instant)
	if not mainPanel or not contentHolder or not minimizeBtn then return end
	slideToken = slideToken + 1
	local myToken = slideToken

	minimizeBtn.Text = isMinimized and "+" or "-"

	if isMinimized then
		savedMainSizeBeforeMin = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_WIDTH, 0, EXPANDED_HEIGHT)
		savedMainPosBeforeMin = mainPanel.Position
		local minSize = UDim2.new(0, PANEL_WIDTH, 0, MINIMIZED_HEIGHT)
		local minPos = UDim2.new(
			savedMainPosBeforeMin.X.Scale,
			savedMainPosBeforeMin.X.Offset,
			savedMainPosBeforeMin.Y.Scale,
			savedMainPosBeforeMin.Y.Offset + 4
		)

		if instant then
			contentHolder.Visible = false
			contentHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -156)
			mainPanel.Size = minSize
			mainPanel.Position = minPos
			return
		end

		local sizeTween = TweenService:Create(
			mainPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
			{ Size = minSize, Position = minPos }
		)
		local contentTween = TweenService:Create(
			contentHolder,
			TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -156) }
		)
		sizeTween:Play()
		contentTween:Play()
		contentTween.Completed:Connect(function()
			if slideToken == myToken and isMinimized and contentHolder then
				contentHolder.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	else
		local restoreSize = savedMainSizeBeforeMin or UDim2.new(0, PANEL_WIDTH, 0, EXPANDED_HEIGHT)
		local restorePos = savedMainPosBeforeMin or mainPanel.Position

		if instant then
			contentHolder.Visible = true
			contentHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36)
			mainPanel.Size = restoreSize
			mainPanel.Position = restorePos
			return
		end

		contentHolder.Visible = true
		contentHolder.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -156)

		local sizeTween = TweenService:Create(
			mainPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Size = restoreSize, Position = restorePos }
		)
		local contentTween = TweenService:Create(
			contentHolder,
			TweenInfo.new(0.26, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 36) }
		)
		sizeTween:Play()
		contentTween:Play()
	end
end

-- Przejście: 1. menu lekko spada w dół i wolniej idzie w górę, a od dołu wyjeżdża 2. menu
local screenSwitchToken = 0

local function setScriptsScreen(openScripts, instant)
	if not mainPanel or not scriptsPanel then return end
	isScriptsScreenOpen = openScripts
	applyMuffledMusicEffect(openScripts)

	screenSwitchToken = screenSwitchToken + 1
	local myToken = screenSwitchToken

	local mainCenterPos = savedMainPosBeforeMin or UDim2.new(0.5, -PANEL_WIDTH / 2, 0.3, -EXPANDED_HEIGHT / 2)
	local mainDipDownPos = UDim2.new(
		mainCenterPos.X.Scale,
		mainCenterPos.X.Offset,
		mainCenterPos.Y.Scale,
		mainCenterPos.Y.Offset + 22
	)
	local mainOffTopPos = UDim2.new(0.5, -PANEL_WIDTH / 2, 0, -EXPANDED_HEIGHT - 60)

	local scriptsCenterPos = UDim2.new(0.5, -SCRIPTS_WIDTH / 2, 0.5, -SCRIPTS_HEIGHT / 2)
	local scriptsOffBottomPos = UDim2.new(0.5, -SCRIPTS_WIDTH / 2, 1, 60)

	if instant then
		if openScripts then
			mainPanel.Visible = false
			mainPanel.Position = mainOffTopPos
			scriptsPanel.Visible = true
			scriptsPanel.Position = scriptsCenterPos
		else
			scriptsPanel.Visible = false
			scriptsPanel.Position = scriptsOffBottomPos
			mainPanel.Visible = true
			mainPanel.Position = mainCenterPos
		end
		return
	end

	if openScripts then
		scriptsPanel.Visible = true
		scriptsPanel.Position = scriptsOffBottomPos
		mainPanel.Visible = true

		local inTween = TweenService:Create(
			scriptsPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.74, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Position = scriptsCenterPos }
		)
		inTween:Play()

		task.spawn(function()
			local dipTween = TweenService:Create(
				mainPanel,
				TweenInfo.new(0.20, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
				{ Position = mainDipDownPos }
			)
			dipTween:Play()
			dipTween.Completed:Wait()
			if screenSwitchToken ~= myToken or not isScriptsScreenOpen or not mainPanel then return end

			local riseTween = TweenService:Create(
				mainPanel,
				TweenInfo.new(0.56, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
				{ Position = mainOffTopPos }
			)
			riseTween:Play()
			riseTween.Completed:Connect(function()
				if screenSwitchToken == myToken and isScriptsScreenOpen and mainPanel then
					mainPanel.Visible = false
				end
			end)
		end)
	else
		mainPanel.Visible = true
		mainPanel.Position = mainOffTopPos
		scriptsPanel.Visible = true

		local outTween = TweenService:Create(
			scriptsPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.54, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
			{ Position = scriptsOffBottomPos }
		)
		local inTween = TweenService:Create(
			mainPanel,
			TweenInfo.new(0.64, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
			{ Position = mainCenterPos }
		)

		outTween:Play()
		inTween:Play()

		outTween.Completed:Connect(function()
			if screenSwitchToken == myToken and (not isScriptsScreenOpen) and scriptsPanel then
				scriptsPanel.Visible = false
			end
		end)
	end
end

-- Efekt lekkiego przyciemnienia liter przy kliknięciu (bez przybliżania/powiększania)
local function attachLetterDimEffect(textObj, normalColor, dimmedColor)

			TweenInfo.new(0.24, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),

		)

	end)
end

-- Podtrzymywanie pozy bohatera po wykonaniu animacji postaci w danym kroku symulacji
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function(_, dt)
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end

	if noclipActive then
		for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				part.CanCollide = false
			end
		end
	end

	local joint, rigType = findRightArmJoint(char)
	if joint then
		if not savedRightShoulderC0 then
			savedRightShoulderC0 = joint.C0
		end

		local targetBlend = heroPoseActive and 1 or 0
		local step = math.clamp((dt or 0.016) * 10, 0, 1)
		currentArmBlend = currentArmBlend + (targetBlend - currentArmBlend) * step

		if currentArmBlend > 0.002 then
			local raisedOffset = (rigType == "R6")
				and CFrame.Angles(math.rad(175), 0, 0)
				or CFrame.Angles(math.rad(165), 0, math.rad(-10))
			local targetC0 = savedRightShoulderC0 * raisedOffset
			joint.C0 = savedRightShoulderC0:Lerp(targetC0, currentArmBlend)
		elseif not heroPoseActive and currentArmBlend <= 0.002 then
			currentArmBlend = 0
			joint.C0 = savedRightShoulderC0
		end
	end
end)

local function toggleFly()
	flying = not flying
	pulseStrokeColor(flying)

	local char = player.Character
	if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then 
		flying = false
		return 
	end

	local root = char.HumanoidRootPart
	local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local lang = getLangPack()

	if flying then
		flyToggleBtn.Text = lang.flyOn
		flyToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
		if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = true end

		bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		bodyVelocity.Parent = root

		bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
		bodyGyro.P = 50000
		bodyGyro.Parent = root
	else
		flyToggleBtn.Text = lang.flyOff
		flyToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
		if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = false end
		if bodyVelocity then pcall(function() bodyVelocity:Destroy() end) end
		if bodyGyro then pcall(function() bodyGyro:Destroy() end) end
		if root then root.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0) end
	end
end

local function toggleNoclip()
	noclipActive = not noclipActive
	pulseStrokeColor(noclipActive)
	local lang = getLangPack()

	if noclipActive then
		noclipToggleBtn.Text = lang.noclipOn
		noclipToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 120)
	else
		noclipToggleBtn.Text = lang.noclipOff
		noclipToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 80, 80)
		local char = player.Character
		if char then
			for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") then
					part.CanCollide = true
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	pcall(function()
		if not flying then return end
		
		local char = player.Character
		if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or not char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then 
			if flying then toggleFly() end
			return 
		end

		local root = char.HumanoidRootPart
		local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true

		local moveVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		if controlModule then
			moveVector = controlModule:GetMoveVector()
		else
			moveVector = humanoid.MoveDirection
		end

		local activeCam = workspace.CurrentCamera or camera
		local camCFrame = activeCam.CFrame
		local camLook = camCFrame.LookVector
		local camRight = camCFrame.RightVector

		local targetVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

		if moveVector.Magnitude > 0.01 then
			targetVelocity = (camLook * (-moveVector.Z) + camRight * moveVector.X) * flySpeed
		end

		if bodyVelocity and bodyVelocity.Parent then
			bodyVelocity.Velocity = targetVelocity
		end

		if bodyGyro and bodyGyro.Parent then
			bodyGyro.CFrame = camCFrame
		end

		if flyCamShakeActive and activeCam then
			local speedRatio = math.clamp(targetVelocity.Magnitude / math.max(flySpeed, 1), 0.25, 1.5)
			local t = tick() * (14 + (flySpeed * 0.05))
			local amp = 0.045 * speedRatio
			local shakeOffset = Vector3.new(
				math.sin(t * 1.13) * amp,
				math.cos(t * 1.47) * amp,
				math.sin(t * 0.89) * (amp * 0.5)
			)
			local shakeTilt = CFrame.Angles(
				math.rad(math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.22 * speedRatio),
				math.rad(math.cos(t * 0.95) * 0.22 * speedRatio),
				math.rad(math.sin(t * 1.65) * 0.35 * speedRatio)
			)
			activeCam.CFrame = camCFrame * CFrame.new(shakeOffset) * shakeTilt
		end
	end)
end)

scripts.summary: A recreation of "survival the Jeff the killer"animation from the killer from the game but it have touch fling
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local movel = 0.1
local running = true

local function fling()
    while running do
        RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()

        local character = player.Character
        local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if hrp then
            local vel = hrp.Velocity

            hrp.Velocity =
                vel * 10000 + Vector3.new(0, 10000, 0)

            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            hrp.Velocity = vel

            RunService.Stepped:Wait()
            hrp.Velocity = vel + Vector3.new(0, movel, 0)

            movel = -movel
        end
    end
end

task.spawn(fling)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local MOVE_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://252557606"
local TOUCH_ANIMATION_ID = "rbxassetid://54584713"
local TOUCH_SOUND_ID = "rbxassetid://566593606"

local character
local humanoid
local animator

local moveTrack
local touchTrack
local touchSound

local touchCooldown = false
local touchToken = 0

local function setupCharacter(char)

    character = char
    humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    if humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
        warn("R6 ONLY!")
        return
    end

    animator = humanoid:WaitForChild("Animator")
    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 30

    local moveAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    moveAnim.AnimationId = MOVE_ANIMATION_ID

    moveTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(moveAnim)
    moveTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    moveTrack.Looped = true

    local touchAnim = Instance.new("Animation")
    touchAnim.AnimationId = TOUCH_ANIMATION_ID

    touchTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(touchAnim)
    touchTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action2
    touchTrack.Looped = false

    touchSound = Instance.new("Sound")
    touchSound.SoundId = TOUCH_SOUND_ID
    touchSound.Volume = 1
    touchSound.Parent = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    touchCooldown = false
    touchToken = 0

    local function checkTouch(otherPart)

        if not otherPart then return end

        local otherCharacter =
            otherPart:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

        if not otherCharacter or otherCharacter == character then
            return
        end

        local otherHumanoid =
            otherCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

        if not otherHumanoid then return end

        if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(otherCharacter) then
            return
        end

        if touchCooldown then return end

        touchCooldown = true
        touchToken += 1

        local currentToken = touchToken

        touchTrack:Play(0.05)

        touchSound:Stop()
        touchSound.TimePosition = 0
        touchSound:Play()

        task.delay(0.5, function()
            if currentToken ~= touchToken then return end

            if touchTrack and touchTrack.IsPlaying then
                touchTrack:Stop(0.05)
            end
        end)

        task.delay(0.5, function()
            if currentToken == touchToken then
                touchCooldown = false
            end
        end)
    end

    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Touched:Connect(checkTouch)
        end
    end

    char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.Touched:Connect(checkTouch)
        end
    end)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(setupCharacter)

if player.Character then
    task.spawn(setupCharacter, player.Character)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()

    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
        return
    end

    humanoid.WalkSpeed = 30

    if not moveTrack or not touchTrack then
        return
    end

    if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 then
        if not moveTrack.IsPlaying then
            moveTrack:Play(0.1)
        end
    else
        if moveTrack.IsPlaying then

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)

    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then

                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then

        end
    end
end

local dropdownOptions = {"Claude", "Gpt-4", "Gemini", "(Groq) Llama", "(Groq) Gpt Oss"}


local function createDropdownOptions()
    local totalHeight = 0
    
    for index, option in ipairs(dropdownOptions) do
        local optionButton = Instance.new("TextButton", G2L["DropdownScroll"])
        optionButton["BorderSizePixel"] = 0
        optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        optionButton["Size"] = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 28)
        optionButton["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, (index - 1) * 28 + 4)
        optionButton["Text"] = option
        optionButton["TextSize"] = 12
        optionButton["TextColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        optionButton["FontFace"] = Font.new([[rbxasset://fonts/families/ComicNeueAngular.json]], Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
        optionButton["ZIndex"] = 27
        
        local optionCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", optionButton)
        optionCorner["CornerRadius"] = UDim.new(0, 3)
        
        optionButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
        end)
        
        optionButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        end)
        
        optionButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            currentAI = option
            G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"]["Text"] = option
            G2L["TextBox_f"]["PlaceholderText"] = "Ask " .. option .. " anything..."
            G2L["DropdownFrame"]["Visible"] = false
            
            AddMessage("System", "Switched to " .. option .. " AI model", false)
        end)
        
        totalHeight = totalHeight + 28
    end
    
    G2L["DropdownScroll"]["CanvasSize"] = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, totalHeight + 8)
end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if G2L["DropdownFrame"]["Visible"] then
            local mouse = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
            local ddFrame = G2L["DropdownFrame"]
            local buttonSize = G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"].AbsoluteSize
            local buttonPos = G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"].AbsolutePosition
            local ddSize = ddFrame.AbsoluteSize
            local ddPos = ddFrame.AbsolutePosition
            
            local mouseX = mouse.X
            local mouseY = mouse.Y
            
            if not (mouseX >= buttonPos.X and mouseX <= buttonPos.X + buttonSize.X and
                    mouseY >= buttonPos.Y and mouseY <= buttonPos.Y + buttonSize.Y) and
               not (mouseX >= ddPos.X and mouseX <= ddPos.X + ddSize.X and
                    mouseY >= ddPos.Y and mouseY <= ddPos.Y + ddSize.Y) then
                G2L["DropdownFrame"]["Visible"] = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

G2L["ImageButton_11"].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if isAIResponding then
        isAIResponding = false
        if currentAIRequest then
            task.cancel(currentAIRequest)
            currentAIRequest = nil
        end
        
        UpdateSendIcon("circle-arrow-up", Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0))
    
        for _, child in ipairs(G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]:GetChildren()) do
            if child.Name == "LoadingMessage" then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end
        
        AddMessage("System", "...", false)
        return
    end
    
    local userMessage = G2L["TextBox_f"].Text
    if userMessage:gsub("%s+", "") == "" then return end
    
    AddMessage("You", userMessage, true)
    G2L["TextBox_f"].Text = ""
    
    UpdateSendIcon("circle-stop", Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
    
    isAIResponding = true
    local loadingMessage, stopAnimation = ShowLoadingMessage()
    
    currentAIRequest = task.spawn(function()
        local aiResponse = CallAI(userMessage)
        
        if isAIResponding then  
            stopAnimation()
            
            if loadingMessage and loadingMessage.Parent then
                loadingMessage:Destroy()
            end
            
            DisplayAIResponse(aiResponse)
        end


        isAIResponding = false
        currentAIRequest = nil
        UpdateSendIcon("circle-arrow-up", Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 0))
    end)
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

local fov = 36

local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then

        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")

                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)

    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
